purpose: Validated customer checkout payload accepted by POST /api/v1/customer/orders.
businessRules: Contains draftOrderId, product IDs, quantities, customer contact, shipping address, delivery mode, payment method, and acceptedTerms only.
draftOrderId is mandatory at service level and must reference an ACTIVE, unexpired customer_order_drafts row for the same authenticated customer and cart signature.
Does not accept price, total, product name, SKU, category, or media values from the browser.
Validation rejects empty carts, invalid contact/address data, and unsupported enum values before service placement.
